title: Keto Pilaf with Sprouts and Cheese
description: A keto-friendly pilaf dish packed with sprouts, cheese, and a hint of richness.

ingredients.name: bean
ingredients.notes: black beans or any other low-carb bean

instructions: Cook the enriched rice according to package instructions.
In a pan, sauté the sprouts and bean in a small amount of oil until tender.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir in pilaf seasoning.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
